item.title: AirLink 0.9.0
item.description:
AirLink now installs as a normal Windows app with a Start menu entry and Installed apps registration. Settings, paired devices and received files stay separate.
Check for Updates is available in the macOS AirLink menu and menu-bar panel, and in Windows Settings and the tray menu. Updates require signed metadata and signed packages. Checks are manual, with no startup polling or system profiling.
This development preview still requires physical Windows installer and native updater acceptance. Token-free update delivery requires the active GitHub repository to be public.
